summary: Runtime hardening flags imposed on both services, bind mounts forbidden and documented, guard mutation-proven by independent re-run; Dockerfile edits comment-only; contract and coverage clean.
notes: contract-check ok=true; not_checked: forbid.behaviors (manually verified below).
acceptance-coverage status=pass, all AC-1..AC-7 covered, no gaps.

Independently re-ran deploy/verificar_endurecimiento.sh in normal mode and --autoprueba: both exit 0; manually mutated a copy removing read_only and confirmed the guard fails via the semantic assertion ('read_only debe ser exactamente true, se obtuvo None'), not via a docker-compose-config resolution failure — the guard genuinely inspects the resolved flags, not just YAML well-formedness.

Confirmed docker compose config always normalizes the volumes section to an explicit {type, source, target} dict even for named-volume short syntax, so the guard's type=='bind' rejection reliably fires against the real resolved shape (no unresolved-vs-resolved mismatch).

Minor non-blocking gap: the guard's volume check only rejects type=='bind'; it does not assert type=='volume' explicitly, so a hypothetical (and currently nonexistent) mount type other than bind/volume for /var/lib/hexcell would not be caught. AC-4 only requires 'no bind-mount form', which the guard satisfies literally; this is a residual hardening opportunity, not a contract or AC violation.

Dockerfile and sidecar/Dockerfile diffs are comment-only (every changed line starts with '#'); independently re-ran the merge-base diff filter from verify command 5 and confirmed empty output (no non-comment lines changed) — build-time hardening from HEX-069 (10001:10001, 0700, shell removal) is byte-identical.
Two-cell isolation demonstration (plan task 17) is declared deferred via a written comment in deploy/cell.compose.yml's volumes block; no isolation demo code/config was added.
No mem_limit/cpus lines and no new ${VARIABLE} were introduced in deploy/cell.compose.yml or deploy/celula.env.ejemplo (grepped the diff for both patterns, zero matches).
All new/changed content (compose comments, env file comments, Dockerfile comment rewording, guard script prose and messages) is in Spanish; no English-language violation found.
Touch list matches exactly the 5 contracted files; diff is 407+/16- against a 650-line global budget and 285 lines for the guard script against its 300-line per_class budget.
